title: Avoid the catalogued artifact-naming anti-patterns

facts.note: Task text mentions authoring, reviewing or using plan artifact names.
Planner-authored files that declare or reference artifact names.

values: artifact name present in authored or touched planner file
facts.note: Observer must extract every candidate artifact-name string in artifact-name positions (produce/consume lists, contract keys, acceptance references), whether new, renamed or pre-existing, and including malformed candidates that do not match theme:aspect[.variant] (e.g. missing theme, wrong separators).
Detector classifying extracted names against the seven catalogued anti-patterns.

fires: Planner declares a new artifact name in a wagon's produce/consume list
Planner renames an artifact in a plan or acceptance
Planner writes a doc or acceptance that uses or references artifact names
Planner reviews a plan containing an existing malformed artifact name such as gesture.raw
doesNotFire: Planner work that declares, uses or references no artifact names
Code identifiers, file names or variable names that are not artifact names

given: A plan, wagon, WMBT, acceptance or doc you author or review declares, uses or references artifact names
when: You write, rename, use or review an artifact name
then: The artifact name matches none of the catalogued anti-patterns.
prefer: Colons between hierarchy levels; a dot only before a variant
Name only the public artifact; internals stay internal
Only hierarchy levels that add distinction; a specific aspect
why: Artifact names are contract keys between wagons; these forms break the theme:aspect.variant grammar, leak internals, or make names vague or duplicative.
evidence: Every artifact name declared, used or referenced in the authored or reviewed planner files matches none of the seven catalogued anti-patterns
For each flagged name, the fix follows the catalogued correction (bad name -> why -> fix)
verifier_detail: Catalogue format: bad name -> why -> fix.
theme_in_aspect: sensory:sensory-feedback.visual -> sensory:feedback.visual (aspect starts with or contains the theme token)

Extraction must not pre-filter on the theme:aspect[.variant] shape: candidates are taken from artifact-name positions (produce/consume, contract keys, artifact references) so malformed names such as gesture.raw (no colon) are inspected and flagged as missing_theme.
